authorization: Human explicitly requested continued unfinished verification after questioning the arbitrary cutoff.
completed_rerun: If completion.json and every referenced product/index hash match, report already_completed without re-auditing saved inputs.
denominators: No survivor means. Fixed original ordering and all missing/failed cell states remain; incomplete whole families stay null under unchanged summary/checker functions.
failed_rows: Failures are recorded and prevent final publication. Other independent rows continue. Prior failed rows require explicit --retry-failed; historical failures remain.
limitations: Observed-history/teacher-forced diagnostic verification only; no autonomous rollout claim.
Original saved source truth and normalization provenance are inherited, not independently re-established.
Diagnostic timing arithmetic does not establish timing truth or end-to-end speedup.
Completion is evidence for independent review, not automatic manuscript admission.
models: Existing base/mix seeds0,1,2 at25000updates; no training or new evaluation by this audit.
old_attempts: All original sources, collections, saved rows, arrays and failed attempt outputs remain unchanged. Old progress labels are not treated as audited numerical checkpoints.
outputs: New standalone successor directory with rows/, checkpoint_index.json, immutable attempts/, audit.json, summary.json, arithmetic_check.json and completion.json.
provenance: phase_sha256 is null because there is no new timed phase. successor_protocol_sha256 and successor_source_pins_sha256 identify this run; prior_failed_phase_sha256 retains old lineage.
resume: Durable per-row values, pairing hashes, check count and task-input/source/runtime identity. Cache file is fsynced and renamed before committed SHA enters fsynced index. Resume hashes every cache record and all original selected inputs before publishing final products. Unindexed orphan rows are recomputed and compared byte-for-byte before index commitment; conflicting orphans are preserved and rejected.
scientific_functions: Frozen original accounting, archive parsing, row metrics/parity/timing/graph/action/pairing checks, whole-denominator aggregates, paired summary and independent arithmetic checker.
scope: Audit all2568 original observed-history cells and preserve all4728 original accounting states from the accepted saved collection.
